name: Fimap
legalEntityNote: Fimap S.p.A. is the Italian company named in the official company details and site footer. Fimap's official privacy policy says the company belongs to a group controlled by Comac S.p.A.; this does not make the two legal entities interchangeable. A model document may identify another manufacturer or agent for a specific machine, so seller, manufacturer, importer and warranty roles require model-level verification.
headline: Fimap cleaning machines, Italian production and procurement checks

ownership.summary: Official Fimap materials identify Fimap S.p.A. as the company behind the brand. Fimap's privacy policy says Fimap belongs to a group controlled by Comac S.p.A. This supports a group-control relationship but does not disclose the exact direct shareholding chain; model-specific manufacturing references remain separate evidence and should not be used to infer the manufacturer of every Fimap machine.
ownership.parentCompany: Comac S.p.A. (group control disclosed; direct shareholding chain not disclosed)

productPortfolio.name: Scrubber dryers
productPortfolio.positioning: Fimap offers walk-behind, ride-on and performance-oriented scrubber dryers for commercial and industrial floorcare.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Compare cleaning width, tanks, brush system, battery, drying, gradients and measured productivity on the intended floor.

productPortfolio.name: Autonomous scrubbing machines
productPortfolio.positioning: The CB-1 collaborative robot is positioned for repetitive large-floor cleaning alongside human operators.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Test navigation, safety, edge coverage, intervention rate, connectivity, charging and reporting in the real facility.

productPortfolio.name: Sweepers and sweeper-scrubbers
productPortfolio.positioning: Sweeping and combined platforms address debris removal and floor washing in larger facilities.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Specify debris, dust control, filtration, discharge, aisle dimensions and the required sweep-scrub sequence.

productPortfolio.name: Vacuum and specialist floorcare machines
productPortfolio.positioning: Vacuum cleaners, spray-extraction cleaners and single-disc machines complement the mechanized range.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Confirm filtration, accessories, chemical compatibility, power standard, consumables and local repair capability.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: Fimap's official company page says it designs and produces its machines in Italy.
manufacturingSupplyChain.scope: Fimap's company-level statement, not proof for every component or individual SKU
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Verify the exact machine's manufacturer plate, assembly site, origin documents and conformity declaration.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: Fimap's official portfolio covers autonomous scrubbers, multiple scrubber families, sweeper-scrubbers, sweepers, vacuums, extractors and single-disc machines.
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Do not extend the supply-chain evidence for one family or manual to another without model documentation.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: The official CB-1 page describes a collaborative autonomous scrubber for repetitive floor-cleaning work.
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Freeze robot hardware, software, safety features, connectivity, battery, accessories and documentation in the purchase specification.

marketsChannels.evidence: Fimap says it exports machines to 80 countries around the world.
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Identify the authorized local seller, importing entity, service organization and spare-parts source before purchase.

marketsChannels.evidence: Fimap Academy publishes training for operators, site managers, business owners and commercial personnel.
marketsChannels.scope: Company training framework; local availability may vary
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Include operator, supervisor and technician training, refresher access and language requirements in the contract.

marketsChannels.evidence: The CB-1 page identifies warehouses, airports, shopping centres, supermarkets and schools as target applications.
marketsChannels.scope: Reference applications rather than guaranteed suitability
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Require a site survey and trial using actual traffic, surfaces, obstacles, shifts and cleaning standards.

competitivePosition.summary: World Clean Biz assessment: Fimap combines a broad Italian professional-floorcare range with autonomous cleaning and training tools. Competitive evaluation should focus on model-level responsibility, real site productivity, software terms and local aftersales execution.

developments.title: CB-1 2.0 is featured in Fimap's autonomous range
developments.summary: Fimap's current official materials present CB-1 as a collaborative autonomous floor-scrubbing platform for large facilities.
